notes.body: What if `len == 0`? then this loop never ends...
I have added code to check len is 0.
left review comments
Not always true, therefore this change should not be applied.

From SPEC: The BSSID field is of the same format as a MAC address.

So I am not sure what is the case for bytes format.

In ieee80211, the most case is MAC format for BSSID.
So What is the case for BYTES format? Please help to explain.
The bytes format is not GUI/human friendly to read BSSID.
